name: zoom
description: Reads Zoom users, meetings, webinars, and bounded module-specific data through the Zoom REST API; includes sensitive Cobrowse SDK session reads, approval-gated clinical-note and Quality Management interaction actions, and a redacted Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key action.

risk.read: external Zoom API read of user, meeting, webinar, Quality of Service, AI Companion, My Notes, healthcare clinical-note, Quality Management, and Cobrowse SDK session data
risk.write: typed Zoom reverse ETL mutation of a healthcare clinical-note completion status or Quality Management interaction creation, plus Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption with redacted output
risk.approval: mutating commands require plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute; Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption additionally requires typed confirmation; read-only commands require none
